questions.qText: A neutral atom always has an equal number of which two subatomic particles?
Which statement correctly defines isotopes?
options: Atoms of the same element with the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
Atoms with the same nucleon number but different proton numbers.
Atoms of different elements with the same number of neutrons.
Ions of the same element with different charges.

options: They have the same nucleon number.
They have the same number of neutrons.
They have the same physical mass.
They have the same number of valence electrons.
